description:
Free remote desktop host - control this Windows PC from iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows or Apple TV.

Remio Host is the free computer-side app of Remio Remote Desktop (remio.net). Install it on a Windows 10 or 11 PC (Home included) and control that PC from the Remio app on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, another Windows PC or Apple TV - at home or over the internet, without opening ports on your router.

This package is the Windows build. Remio Host also runs on macOS, Linux, Raspberry Pi and FreeBSD: https://remio.net/download

Up to 6K at 120 FPS with hardware H.264/H.265, the PC's sound, clipboard, file transfer and game controllers, and a phone, tablet or another computer as a second display. End-to-end encrypted and direct between your devices by default. Pair by scanning a QR code or typing the Device ID and PIN - no account needed. Free with no time limit; Remio Pro is optional.

Runs as a Windows Service so it survives reboots and log-offs, and updates itself.
Remio Host 3.8.10 - This update keeps the picture steady when nothing on the screen moves, lets your clicks through while the computer's screen is blanked, and keeps your session on its own screens when the PC's monitor wakes up.
